data.body:
Residual-gap disposition sweep before epic close (Phase 5 of the rebar-implement protocol):

1. applier.py's isinstance(m, MutationShape) ternary (ADR 0107 step 4 target (b)) -- ACCEPTED, justified. Empirically only one of its two call shapes is dead in production; the other is a real, extensively-tested, currently-documented apply(mutations: list[dict], ...) calling convention unrelated to payload typing. Deleting it broke ~50 tests. Recorded on 3f27-cb3c-8023-4f57 and in docs/architecture.md's 'Typed outbound mutation payloads (ADR 0107)' section.

2. AC7 deletion-census items NOT deleted (typed_dispatch._LEAVES/_apply_typed, payload_shadow.py, MutationShape, _mutation_to_batch_dict itself) -- ACCEPTED, justified. Each was census-checked (dual Serena + grep-as-string) and found to have genuine non-test-only consumers, or to be the designated regression-oracle infrastructure itself (payload_shadow.py is the portable shadow-replay oracle's own machinery). None were dead legacy.

3. e9d5's landing (Gerrit 2436) surfaced a genuine, deterministic test-isolation bug: an autouse _network_guard fixture using mock.patch.object collided with monkeypatch.setattr in a new test, permanently leaking a network-block guard into later tests -- FIXED IN SCOPE within 2436 itself (fixture switched to unittest.mock.patch.object; RED->GREEN regression test added). Tracked and closed as bug edeb-c3ad-c051-4e6a.

4. AC5's live-DC local-arm64 attempt (3f27) reproduced the harness README's own documented arm64-emulation limitation (Jira never finishes booting under emulation) -- ACCEPTED as an honest, non-fabricated limitation of this dev host, not a shipped gap: the new jira-dc-exact-patchset.yml CI workflow gives the live lane a wired path on native amd64 GitHub Actions, and was itself dispatched and run live (workflow run 33455991406: 74 passed, 1 skipped, 1 xfailed, 0 failed) as closing evidence for 3f27's AC1-AC4, so the live-DC gap is now closed, not merely deferred.

No filed follow-up tickets were needed beyond edeb (already closed). All 11 stories closed; all three epic outcomes (A/A1 typed reconciler, B runner lifecycle, C operation configuration) covered and verified.
